name: io.github.kato9292929/agentpay402-mcp
title: AgentPay402 MCP
description: Pay for x402 APIs safely with your own wallet: Seller Probe check, on-chain proof, receipt refetch.

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Wallet that pays: cdp, privy or crossmint; none runs only the discovery and checking tools.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVY_WALLET_ID
environmentVariables.description: Privy Ethereum server wallet ID that pays on Base (WALLET_PROVIDER=privy).

environmentVariables.name: NVM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Nevermined API key for nvm:erc4337 credit plans (sandbox: with testnet, live: with mainnet).

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: testnet (Base Sepolia, Solana Devnet) or mainnet (real USDC on Base and Solana).

environmentVariables.name: X402_PER_CALL_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Largest single payment in USD; anything above it is refused before signing.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PER_SESSION_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Total USD that may be paid while the server runs.

environmentVariables.name: X402_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hosts that may be paid; empty allows every host.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PROBE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: When Seller Probe recorded the host as paid but not delivered: block, warn or off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRICE_MISMATCH
environmentVariables.description: When the 402 price differs from the Bazaar listing: block, warn or off.

environmentVariables.name: X402_RETRY_WITH_RECEIPT
environmentVariables.description: Refetch once with the same payment from Delivery Receipt sellers after a failed delivery.

environmentVariables.name: X402_REPORT_TO_PROBE
environmentVariables.description: Send an anonymous not_delivered report to Seller Probe.
